IDYA.why_line: DB lock 1H April, PFS webcast May. 96% Warpspeed P(success). $3.50 calls targeting 2.4x. Data drops in ~10 days.
IDYA.edge_line: IR page added 'webcast May 2026' post-March-22 shift. Ph1/2 showed ~3x PFS gain. Endpoint is PFS — OS (coin flip) is not scored.

TVTX.why_line: PDUFA April 13 — 13 days out. FILSPARI already approved for IgAN; sNDA just expands label to FSGS. 77% P(success), 2.4x target.
TVTX.edge_line: Jan Major Amendment = data review only, not safety/mfg. DUPLEX showed strong proteinuria reduction. OI=8,438 = institutional conviction.

RGNX.why_line: Phase 3 AFFINITY DUCHENNE readout April-May. 68% P(success), 2.3x on $1k. Jul-17 gives 15+ days buffer past expected window.
RGNX.edge_line: Primary endpoint is biomarker expression >=10% — NOT NSAA score. Far lower bar than typical DMD trials. 65 patients enrolled.

AXSM.why_line: PDUFA April 30 — 30 days. Priority Review + Breakthrough Therapy for AXS-05 Alzheimer's agitation. 85% P(success), 2.9x on $680.
AXSM.edge_line: Same drug as AUVELITY (approved) — safety/mfg cleared. BTD + Priority Review = FDA sees value. Market underprices dual designation together.

ARGX.why_line: PDUFA May 10 — 40 days. argenx 100% FDA approval rate on all prior sNDAs. $750/$800 call spread targets 4.4x on $1.3k.
ARGX.edge_line: Expansion #4: efgartigimod approved seropositive gMG, ITP, CIDP. Same drug, same mechanism. FDA has never rejected an argenx sNDA.

RVMD.why_line: RASolute 302 OS data May-June. Stock +144% since entry, strike updated to $125 (35% OTM). 1 contract only — OI=59, thin liquidity.
RVMD.edge_line: Enrollment complete Q1 2026 — PDAC median OS ~12mo, events accumulate fast. Options market hasn't repriced to reflect stock's new level.

AGIO.why_line: Warpspeed: 6% success vs. street's 50/50. 7 Aug-21 $17.5P at $945. Trial fails = stock -55%, puts pay 3.6x.
AGIO.edge_line: Trial powered for 40% TI rate; Ph2 showed ~20%. 8-week TI endpoint unrealistic for LR-MDS. Endpoint design mismatch = near-certain fail.

NTLA.why_line: Only Phase 3 in vivo CRISPR globally. HAELO topline 1H 2026, BLA 2H 2026. 82% P(success), 3.5x on $875. RMAT designated.
NTLA.edge_line: Ph1/2 NEJM: 95% HAE attack reduction. Endpoint is attack rate wks 5-28, 60pts, crossover allowed. RMAT = FDA already on expedited path.

VRDN.why_line: Stock near cash after 35% crash on hearing signal. REVEAL-2 (chronic TED) on track Q2 2026. 80% P(success), 2.9x. $875M cash.
VRDN.edge_line: Hearing signal was in ACTIVE TED — REVEAL-2 is CHRONIC TED, different exposure. Street sold both. Veligrotug PDUFA June 30 = free catalyst.

LPCN.why_line: LPCN 1154 PPD readout Q2 2026. 62% P(success). 131 equity shares at $993. Win = +80% to ~$13.60. No options market.
LPCN.edge_line: No options = no IV or hedge pressure. FDA pathway set post-ZULRESSO/ZURZUVAE. Thin coverage = price discovery gap not yet competed away.
